decision.record: Orchestrator decision: B24 timed defer and wake
decision.adoptedBehavior: No timed defer in this burst. Plug defer is untimed; explicit bead.reopen makes deferred work workable again.
decision.scope: defer and explicit reopen only; not the entire B24 card

reference.recordingStatus: retained independent reference; no recorder rerun or new reference recording

defer.reasonProjection: A nonempty supplied reason appends a comment in the same ChangeSet; it does not append to a notes field.
defer.expectProjection: Supplied preconditions pass into the ChangeSet.

reopen.effect: Explicit transition out of defer; ready when the ontology and other ready predicates permit it.

plug.readAfterClockAdvance: Reading ready does not synthesize a wake or a write.
plug.statusVocabulary: Ontology-defined; do not require the reference status strings.
plug.evidenceScope: Pinned contract and source projection, with the existing controlled category/reopen fixture; no new connected runtime qualification in this record.

cases.plugProjection: Untimed defer selects the defer slot and excludes otherwise-ready work. An optional reason becomes a comment; explicit bead.reopen restores the unstarted slot.
No expiry wake makes the deferred item automatically claimable. Explicit bead.reopen is the supported path back to otherwise-ready work.
There is no dated defer request or automatic expiry wake. An untimed defer remains deferred until an explicit bead.reopen.
No dated ephemeral wake is supported by the admitted contract; this record supplies no positive plane-specific timed qualification.
There is no future target field. Untimed defer has no time-based release.
Explicit bead.reopen selects the unstarted slot; otherwise-ready work becomes ready. There is no target-time field to clear, and existing comments remain.

limits: The retained reference uses the runtime clock and omits timestamps. Fixed past/future inputs and matching repeated digests are outcome evidence, not a controlled-time certificate.
No positive timed-defer, timed-wake, exact-boundary, Go/SQL clock-twin, or full B24 qualification is claimed.
The older B24 behavior card and recorded keep disposition remain historical catalog evidence; they do not expand this adopted untimed contract.
Reason semantics differ: the reference permits an omitted reason but rejects an explicitly blank one; Plug has an optional reason represented as a comment.
Historical failures and missing controlled reference input remain unresolved by this decision record. No golden, raw reference, provenance, or original test is rewritten.
Stale/due behavior, other drivers, and the separate connected deviation acceptance are outside this record.
